items.title: Benefits of OOP: Modularity, Reusability, and Easier Maintenance (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Benefits of OOP with its Tidbit (PDF 37, printed 33).

blocks.text: OOP code ko modules (hisson) mein baant deti hai, is liye code sambhalna aasan hota hai. Classes aur objects kai programs ya program ke kai hisson mein dobara istemal ho sakte hain, is se aik hi code baar baar likhna nahi parta. OOP se bane programs ko sambhalna aur update karna aasan hai, kyunke aik hisse ki tabdeeli poore system par asar nahi dalti. OOP ki banawat software ko barhne (scalability) aur halaat ke mutabiq dhalne (adaptability) mein madad deti hai. Yeh code ko samajhne ke qabil aur munazzam bana kar team ke saath mil kar kaam (collaboration) bhi behtar karti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming programmers ko asal zindagi ki cheezon, jaise students ya gariyon, ki soorat mein sochne deti hai, is liye programs samajhna aur sambhalna aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Object-Oriented Programming kya hai, aur is ke do fawaid kya hain?
blocks.explanation: OOP classes aur objects se programs design karti hai jo haqeeqi cheezon ka model hain. Fawaid mein modularity (code qabil-e-intizam classes mein) aur reusability (code dobara likhne ke bajaye classes dobara use) shamil hain; dekh-bhaal bhi asan hoti hai.

items: Reusability: classes aur objects dobara istemal.
Aasan maintenance, scalability aur behtar team work.
